instruction: Write an XDP/eBPF program that redirects IPv4 TCP and UDP packets to two separately configured egress interfaces via array map 'proto_redirect_map' (type BPF_MAP_TYPE_ARRAY, key __u32 [0=TCP, 1=UDP], val __u32 ifindex, max_entries 2). For TCP, lookup key 0; for UDP, lookup key 1. If lookup succeeds and *ifindex != 0, return bpf_redirect(*ifindex, 0). If ifindex == 0 or for other protocols (ICMP, GRE, non-IPv4), return XDP_PASS.
requirements: If ip->protocol == IPPROTO_TCP, lookup key 0 in proto_redirect_map; if *val > 0 return bpf_redirect(*val, 0)
If ip->protocol == IPPROTO_UDP, lookup key 1 in proto_redirect_map; if *val > 0 return bpf_redirect(*val, 0)
Return XDP_PASS for other protocols and non-IPv4 traffic
GPL license and SEC("xdp") entry point

tests.name: tcp_default_pass
tests.description: TCP packet with unconfigured map (ifindex=0) must return XDP_PASS

tests.name: udp_default_pass
tests.description: UDP packet with unconfigured map must return XDP_PASS

tests.name: vlan_tcp_pass
tests.description: VLAN TCP frame must return XDP_PASS

tests.name: truncated_ip_pass
tests.description: Truncated IP header must return XDP_PASS safely
